verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a live llms.txt at developers.figma.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with LLM-oriented content describing Figma's developer platform, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Figma also documents agent-guidance material such as project-level custom rules for its MCP server. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage beyond its header (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), independent or hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.figma.com/llms.txt # Figma Developer Documentation
